title: Room in the Sunshine
originalStory: Mina tucked her chin into her woolly scarf and spotted a sparrow puffing up its feathers under a bush. “You have a fluffy coat too,” she whispered. She sat quietly while it hopped for seeds, happy to share the little sunny garden.
visualBible:
Mina: human child, age 5, normal human ears, short dark-brown bob, warm brown skin, mustard-yellow woolly scarf, teal coat, plum trousers, brown shoes, small child-sized build.
Mama: adult woman, age 34, normal human ears, dark-brown hair in a long braid, warm brown skin, rust-red coat, cream scarf, navy trousers, brown shoes, tall adult-sized build.
Pip: small real house sparrow, round brown-and-gray body, chestnut-streaked wings, pale gray belly, short dark beak, tiny dark feet.

pages.text: Mina tucked her chin into her woolly scarf and spotted a sparrow puffing up its feathers under a bush. “You have a fluffy coat too,” she whispered. She sat quietly on the garden bench while the sparrow hopped for seeds in a little patch of sunshine.
pages.illustrationScene: Soft watercolor in a Sulu Boya mood, with translucent washes and delicate paper texture. In a sunny winter garden, Mina sits on a low wooden bench, chin tucked into her mustard-yellow scarf. Several feet away, Pip has puffed feathers beneath a leafy bush, with a few naturally fallen seeds on the soil. Show the peaceful space between Mina and Pip; no other characters are visible.

pages.text: A cloud slipped over the sun as Mama sat beside Mina. “Do you think the sparrow will come and sit with us?” Mina asked. “Perhaps,” Mama said, “but we can keep a little room for a friend who likes room.”
pages.illustrationScene: Soft Sulu Boya watercolor, close view of the low bench beside the garden's paved patio. Mina, small in her teal coat and mustard-yellow scarf, sits close to Mama, a clearly taller adult with a long braid, rust-red coat, and cream scarf. Mina looks up with a hopeful expression while Mama answers warmly. A soft cloud dims the garden light; only Mina and Mama are visible.

pages.text: Under the bush, the sparrow scratched aside a dry leaf and found one tiny seed. Then the cloud drifted on, and sunlight spread across the soil like a golden blanket. Hop, hop—the sparrow followed its warm edge.
pages.illustrationScene: Soft Sulu Boya watercolor, ground-level close-up beneath the garden bush. Pip is the only visible character, taking a small hop along the edge of a sunlit patch of soil. A dry leaf lies beside a tiny seed, and gentle golden light filters through the leaves. Keep Pip realistic, small, and unhurried.

pages.text: The sunshine reached Mina's shoes, too. The sparrow stayed near the bush, and Mina stayed on her bench, with a whole warm patch between them. “We don't have to sit close,” she whispered, “to share something lovely.”
pages.illustrationScene: Soft Sulu Boya watercolor, a wide view across the quiet garden. Mina sits contentedly on the low bench, her brown shoes touched by sunlight, while Pip stands near the bush several feet away. The broad golden patch between Mina and Pip is the picture's gentle focus, suggesting companionship without crowding. Only Mina and Pip are visible.
